description: This is a Java entity class representing a 'Category' in an e-commerce domain, using JPA/Hibernate for ORM. It includes fields for category properties, relationships to descriptions, parent category, merchant store, and child categories. It also manages auditing via an embedded AuditSection and listens to audit events.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class representing product categories, with properties such as code, image, description list, parent/child relationships, and metadata like visibility and depth.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the category.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section containing audit info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: getCategoryImage

methods.name: setCategoryImage

methods.name: getSortOrder
